name: demo-c-handle-reel-02
title: Handle Reel Interactive Roll
description: Interactive trigger handle reel with custom role names and a tactile roll button.

'use client' import * as React from 'react' import { HandleReel } from '@/components/spaceui/handle-reel' import { Button } from '@/components/spaceui/button-squircle' import { IconRotateDot } from '@tabler/icons-react' const CREATIVE_ROLES = [ 'engineer', 'designer', 'architect', 'builder', 'founder', 'creator', 'developer', 'maker', ] export default function Demo() { const [trigger, setTrigger] = React.useState(0) const [finalRole, setFinalRole] = React.useState('creator') const handleRoll = () => { const nextRoles = CREATIVE_ROLES.filter((r) => r !== finalRole) const randomNext = nextRoles[Math.floor(Math.random() * nextRoles.length)] setFinalRole(randomNext) setTrigger((t) => t + 1) } return (
) }
